transcript: A great career is rarely built completely alone. Every opportunity I've gotten in my life is because people helped me out. Take Shreya's example within the ServiceNow ecosystem. Hey Ishan, so I am working as a technical product owner. I have about five years of experience, and I'm very happy to be part of the World Forum. Who was that one person who helped you through your journey, like when you first got started? One of the person is Sujan Dutta. So he's currently the developer advocate in ServiceNow. So he was the guy where he was like very much guiding me in every sort of thing. Shreya, why is it important to learn in a community setup? I would say that ServiceNow community is one place where if you have any questions, any doubts, if you want to network, if you want to learn something new about ServiceNow, if you want to even learn ServiceNow from scratch, community is for you. ServiceNow University is an amazing platform where you can go and learn about new skills that can help you jumpstart in your career. There are over 1,000 free courses where you can learn all of this and more. TLDR, your first step does not have to be a solo journey. Sign up for ServiceNow University with the link in my bio and start learning for free.
